notes: This file describes what YOUR Seedance / Dreamina account can do in its web UI. Nothing here is checked automatically and there is no API integration.
Values are unverified starter values. Open Dreamina, check the model list, clip lengths, reference-image limit and aspect ratios, then edit this file and set verified: true.
null means unknown; prompts treat it as 'do not rely on this'.

models.label: Seedance (Dreamina web UI)
models.notes: Unverified. Image-to-video from one first-frame image is the assumed main mode. If your plan offers multi-reference generation, add reference_to_video and raise max_reference_images.

generation_modes.image_to_video: First-frame image + motion prompt. The first frame carries the character's identity, so make it from the character's own references.
generation_modes.reference_to_video: Several reference images + prompt (only if your plan shows it).
generation_modes.text_to_video: Prompt only. No identity control; B-roll without the character only.
